review_type: fresh independent targeted source, actual-render and interaction review
verdict: Material software parity gaps remain. Not 10/10.

scores.scale: Qualitative exact-C#-parity judgments, not completion percentages. Overall gives equal weight to UI/UX and features.

rationale: Run 13 closes the three Rover tuning findings from round 12. Rover controls no longer stage. The Avoidance group follows the original SONAR_TRIGGER_CM/RNGFND_TRIGGR_CM predicate, and the round-13 Rover capture shows it hidden. Combo controls get metadata descriptions. View KML now serves a working network.kml with location.kml, wps.kml and the aircraft model, and the KML content matches httpserver.cs closely. Real but small residuals remain. Rover direct writes fail silently where the original shows 'Set X Failed!'. Rover numeric edits have no 300 ms debounce and no optimistic display. The Rust server is loopback-only and starts on click, whereas the original listens on all interfaces from startup. Reading httpserver.cs also turns up a gap no earlier round recorded. The same original service provides MJPEG HUD/map streams, MAVLink websockets, the Mavelous UI, guided/command_long/rcoverride/get_mission HTTP APIs, hud.html and georef KML. The port provides none of these. The large retained gaps (video, PLAN coordinate systems, swarm tools, plugins, localization, transports/mobile, display flags) are unchanged. Credit for the closures is partly offset by the newly recorded HTTP-service gap, so features rises only slightly.

The Rover test covers one numeric up-arrow click that writes without Ctrl+S and reads back from the simulator. Rover combo direct writes, rejected or timed-out direct writes and rapid repeated clicks were checked in source only.
The KML test is an HTTP-level test. Google Earth was not run, and the click-to-browser path (open_url) was not executed.
Native macOS, Linux, Android and iOS launch/import behavior and the complete original feature set were not exhaustively exercised.
No physical device was used. Physical flight qualification is separate from this software parity review.
scope.reviewer_actions: Read-only source and render inspection. Only judging/round-13.json was written.

run13_dispositions.change: Rover Basic Tuning direct writes (no staging)
run13_dispositions.closed_parts: prepare enables staging only for plane_tuning. With staged == None, FormState::edit sends SetParam immediately for numeric, combo and check controls, matching the original Rover controls, which have no ValueUpdated subscribers and call setParam themselves. The egui test clicks a Rover numeric up arrow, sends no Ctrl+S, and observes the simulator ACK and readback. Plane staging and its no-early-write test are retained. Write Params with an empty change set is a no-op, consistent with the original's empty changes table.
run13_dispositions.remaining: Direct writes bypass VehicleTuning.waiting, so a rejected or timed-out write raises ParamSet{ok:false} with no handler and the user gets no message. The original shows ErrorSetValueFailed or 'Set X Failed!'. Numeric clicks each send a write immediately instead of the original 300 ms debounce. The control shows the old value until readback, while the original keeps the typed value. Combo direct writes are untested.

run13_dispositions.closed_parts: The page sets st.visible[groupBox1] from the presence of SONAR_TRIGGER_CM or RNGFND_TRIGGR_CM. forms::hidden walks parent chains, so descendants hide with the group. The round-13 Rover capture shows the group absent with a fixture that lacks both parameters. The predicate is re-evaluated every frame, which also covers parameters that arrive later.
run13_dispositions.remaining: No present-parameter render (legacy SONAR or current RNGFND) was supplied. The parent-walk logic makes a binding failure unlikely.

run13_dispositions.change: Metadata tooltips and ranges on tuning combo/numeric controls
run13_dispositions.closed_parts: parameter_metadata is now independent of staging. Combo responses get the metadata description on hover, and numeric controls keep metadata range and increment. This matches the Plane and Rover Activate tooltip loops and MavlinkNumericUpDown.setup, which always consults metadata for ranges.
run13_dispositions.remaining: Tracker also receives tooltips, which the original ConfigAntennaTracker does not set. This is a harmless addition. Truncated combo text has no full-text hover, which the original's wider combos did not need.

run13_dispositions.change: PLAN View KML loopback network.kml server
run13_dispositions.status: closed for the View KML workflow; broader httpserver gap recorded as new
run13_dispositions.closed_parts: Clicking View KML binds port 56781, pushes the current mission and link snapshot, and opens http://127.0.0.1:56781/network.kml. The failure text matches the original. network.kml has the original two NetworkLinks: location.kml with onInterval/1 s refresh and flyToView=1, and wps.kml with flyToView=0. location.kml emits one Model placemark per vehicle ('P/Q alt', clamped to 0.01, heading=yaw, tilt=-pitch, roll=-roll, scale 2, block_plane_0.dae) and a LookAt (tilt 80, range 50) when the active position is non-zero. wps.kml emits WP placemarks with home first as 'H', plus 'WPs' absolute (ff00ffff) and 'onground' clampToGround (7f00ffff) line strings. The model is bundled and served. The mission snapshot refreshes every frame, so the next request reflects edits. The HTTP test covers all of this.
run13_dispositions.remaining: The original starts the server at MainV2 startup on IPAddress.Any. The port starts it on first click and binds 127.0.0.1, so LAN Google Earth clients cannot connect and links do not resolve before the click. If the port is already taken, the port shows an error rather than opening the URL as the original does. location.kml skips links that are not Connected, while the original iterates all Comports. Google Earth was not exercised.

run13_dispositions.change: Plane staging and Rover direct-write egui tests through simulator readback
run13_dispositions.closed_parts: numeric_roundtrip is parameterized by vehicle kind, form, parameter and staging mode. Plane asserts no early write before Ctrl+S, and Rover asserts the write arrives without it. Both assert the simulator ACK and the final value.
run13_dispositions.remaining: Combo, rejection and timeout paths are not exercised.

new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.title: Provide the rest of the original embedded HTTP/websocket service
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.finding: Newly recorded, though not new in the code. The original httpserver, started at application launch on port 56781 on all interfaces, also serves: MAVLink websockets (/websocket/server and raw at /), MJPEG /hud.jpg, /map.jpg and /both.jpg streams, /hud.html, georefnetwork.kml, the Mavelous UI (/mav/, /mavlink/), guided GET/POST, command_long, rcoverride and get_mission HTTP APIs, and an index page. The Rust kml_server answers only network/location/wps/model and returns 404 for everything else. No other module in crates/ implements these endpoints. External tools that use these endpoints (web HUD, Mavelous, HTTP guided control) do not work.
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.next_fix: Start the service at launch on the original binding and add the HUD/map MJPEG streams, websocket MAVLink bridge, guided/command_long/rcoverride/get_mission APIs, hud.html, georef KML and index. Verify each endpoint with HTTP and websocket client tests against the simulator.

new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.title: Report failed direct writes and match the numeric write timing
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.finding: Rover and Tracker direct writes call link.send(SetParam) without registering a waiter. A rejected or timed-out write raises ParamSet{ok:false}, which VehicleTuning.on_event ignores because waiting is None, so the user sees nothing. The original MavlinkNumericUpDown timer and MavlinkComboBox show error message boxes. Numeric edits also skip the original 300 ms coalescing. The control displays the old value until the vehicle echoes the new one.
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.next_fix: Track direct writes per page and raise the original error on ok:false. Coalesce numeric writes over 300 ms and show the edited value while the write is pending. Test a rejected Rover numeric write and a Rover combo selection against the simulator.

new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.title: Match server lifetime and binding
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.finding: The KML server starts on the first View KML click and binds only to 127.0.0.1. The original listens on IPAddress.Any from startup. LAN Google Earth clients and network links opened before the click cannot reach it. A port conflict produces an error instead of opening the URL.
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.next_fix: Fold this into the startup HTTP service above. Keep View KML as the URL opener.
